topic: Pages across Datadog fail to load for one user
symptom_pattern: One user reports that multiple pages across the product (dashboards, logs) fail to load or spin forever; colleagues in the same org are fine.
root_cause: Corrupted local browser state (cookies/cache/site data) for the Datadog domain.
resolution_path: Ask whether it happens in other orgs/browsers/incognito
Have them clear site data for the Datadog domain
Collect a HAR or console errors if it persists

qa_pairs.tse_question: Does it happen in an incognito window?
Is it every org you belong to?
